item.title: More seniors stay in the workforce after rule change
item.description: The number of pensioners who continue working has increased by 49 percent over the past three years, according to new figures. By the end of 2025, 97,263 people were employed while also receiving a state pension, according to a December report from the Danish Agency for Labour Market and Recruitment. item.title: Denmark will send four F35 fighter jets to NATO Arctic mission
item.description: Denmark will send four F35 fighter jets to NATO’s Arctic Sentry mission, Defence Minister Troels Lund Poulsen said Friday. The Danish jets will be based in Iceland and will take part in already planned training with Swedish Gripen fighter jets. item.description: The European Commission will investigate whether a capital injection of 15.4 million euros into PostNord Logistics follows EU rules on state aid, Reuters reported.
